info.description:
Generated from canonical TypeBox schemas, source descriptions and handler annotations. Do not edit; run bun run api:generate.

Daemon-to-web HTTP endpoints. Authentication is optional when not configured; origin, ownership and secret-exclusion policies still apply. HEAD follows GET, OPTIONS reports allowed methods, and missing methods return 405. Streaming media descriptions identify SSE/NDJSON item schemas. WebSocket framing and command exchanges are generated separately as AsyncAPI documents.

delete.description:
### Usage

Delete an allowed auth-broker credential block through the sharing proxy.

### Inputs

Supply host bearer authentication and an allowed path; query and selected headers pass through, and a body is limited to 1 MiB.

### Invariants

Admission is repeated after reading the body; disallowed paths are refused and payload semantics belong to the broker.

### Effects

Forwards the deletion and passes through upstream status and body; revocation can abort in-flight work.

### Recovery

After an uncertain response, consult broker state before repeating the deletion.

### Additional protocol details

Only content-type, accept, if-none-match, and omp-auth-broker-capabilities request headers and content-type, etag, cache-control, and vary response headers pass through. Query strings are forwarded; broker payload formats are intentionally opaque.

### Usage

Read an allowed auth-broker resource through the host credential-sharing proxy.

### Inputs

Supply a host bearer token, allowed path and optional query; only selected request headers pass through.

### Invariants

The non-local host must remain admitted for credential sharing; paths outside the allow-list are refused and payloads remain broker-defined.

### Effects

Forwards the request and streams the upstream status and body with selected response headers.

### Recovery

Re-establish sharing or service availability after refusal; revocation can abort an in-flight request.

### Additional protocol details

Only content-type, accept, if-none-match, and omp-auth-broker-capabilities request headers and content-type, etag, cache-control, and vary response headers pass through. Query strings are forwarded; broker payload formats are intentionally opaque.

get.description:
### Usage

Download a file belonging to the current cluster configuration.

### Inputs

Authenticate as a cluster member and supply the lowercase 64-character content hash in the path.

### Invariants

Membership is checked again after building the configuration; hashes absent from the current manifest, including older versions, return 404.

### Effects

Returns raw application/octet-stream bytes with no-store; it does not apply configuration.

### Recovery

Fetch a fresh manifest if the hash is no longer present; restore membership or service availability after an admission failure.

### Additional protocol details

The hash addresses content in the current manifest, not an older configuration.

401.description: Missing or invalid host bearer token.

403.description: The host is not a cluster member.

404.description: Hash is invalid or absent from the current manifest.

503.description: The host registry or required service is unavailable.

x-client-semantics.Effects: Returns raw application/octet-stream bytes with no-store; it does not apply configuration.
x-client-semantics.Inputs: Authenticate as a cluster member and supply the lowercase 64-character content hash in the path.
x-client-semantics.Invariants: Membership is checked again after building the configuration; hashes absent from the current manifest, including older versions, return 404.
x-client-semantics.Recovery: Fetch a fresh manifest if the hash is no longer present; restore membership or service availability after an admission failure.
x-client-semantics.Usage: Download a file belonging to the current cluster configuration.

get.description:
### Usage

Fetch the master's current mirrored configuration manifest.

### Inputs

Authenticate with a cluster member's host bearer token.

### Invariants

Membership is checked both before and after building the current configuration; the response is not cached by HTTP clients.

### Effects

Reads the current configuration and returns JSON; it does not apply it to the daemon.

### Recovery

On revoked membership or unavailable configuration, restore admission or configuration availability before retrying.

### Additional protocol details

Returns the master's current mirrored configuration.

schema.description: The master's current mirrored files, agent environment, and plugin state.

agentEnv.description: Agent environment values mirrored from the master.

hash.description: Content hash used to fetch the file.

path.description: Path relative to the selected root.

root.description: The omp agent directory or the host's home directory.

get.description:
### Usage

Connect a host daemon's WebSocket to the server hub.

### Inputs

Supply the host bearer token and WebSocket upgrade request.

### Invariants

The hub authenticates before upgrading; the ordinary proxy gate does not handle this path.

### Effects

A successful upgrade hands the socket to the hub rather than returning a normal HTTP response.

### Recovery

Reconnect after a dropped link; an upgrade refusal requires correcting authentication or availability.

### Additional protocol details

The hello is the first WebSocket frame. The server refuses upgrades while shutting down.

post.description:
### Usage

Detect a daemon using the obsolete HTTP hello protocol.

### Inputs

The legacy hello POST is not used to establish a link.

### Invariants

This endpoint refuses legacy clients rather than negotiating a session.

### Effects

Returns an upgrade-required response; no WebSocket is established.

### Recovery

Update the daemon and connect using the WebSocket link.

### Additional protocol details

The hello body is inspected for its version, but malformed or oversized bodies are also refused.

schema.description: Obsolete hello payload; only an integer v is inspected.
